therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque imaging / PET tracer uptake
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Healthy participants and Alzheimer's Disease patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety (AEs), radiation dosimetry (effective dose), and brain cortical SUVR differentiating AD from healthy participants

results.effect_size: Mean cortical SUVR: AD 1.75 vs HE 1.34 (p<0.01); Effective dose 18.2 µSv/MBq
results.target_engagement_evidence: Significantly higher brain cortical SUVR in AD participants vs healthy (1.75 vs 1.34, p<0.01), consistent with amyloid plaque binding
biomarker_changes: Mean brain cortical SUVR in AD participants (Part II): 1.75
Mean brain cortical SUVR in HE participants (Part II): 1.34
LS Mean posterior cingulate gyrus SUVR in AD (Part III): 1.47
LS Mean posterior cingulate gyrus SUVR in HE (Part III): 1.35
LS Mean difference (AD vs HE) posterior cingulate gyrus: 0.12 (90% CI: -0.04–0.27)
Highest organ effective doses: Ovaries 3.06 µSv/MBq, Urinary Bladder Wall 2.75 µSv/MBq, Red Marrow 2.36 µSv/MBq, Lungs 1.71 µSv/MBq
subgroup_findings: AD participants had significantly higher cortical SUVR than healthy participants (1.75 vs 1.34, p<0.01)
Posterior cingulate gyrus SUVR difference between AD and HE was 0.12 (90% CI: -0.04–0.27) in Part III, not statistically significant
safety_signals: 8 of 19 participants experienced at least one AE
No participants discontinued due to an AE

dose_info.schedule: single IV dose (Part I and II); second dose in Part III

context.duration: Up to 14 days after last dose
